product_name: Catvision high-Performance Android | Latest Android v12 | 4GB RAM |32GB ROM | Dual Band Wi-Fi | Bluetooth Remote | BIS Approved
description: Video & Audio: Catvision Android supports almost all audio and video formats and 4K video decoding, giving an enhanced visual experience. Processor & OS: Powered by the Android 12 OS which has a stronger stability and faster process speed. You can download apps from Google Play Store/App Store. Runs fast and smooth. 4GB RAM 32GB ROM: Catvision Box is loaded with 4GB RAM, 32GB Flash Memory which ensures the box runs stably and smoothly. In addition, you can also extend the memory through microSD card or USB device. Wi-Fi Connectivity: The box has built-in Dual Band Wi-Fi and supports 10/100M RJ-45 Ethernet. Its wider coverage and faster loading speed avoid the problem of mutual interference while ensuring a stable network environment. Bluetooth Voice Remote: The Bluetooth remote control provides 360 Degree connectivity giving you the freedom to place the box anywhere, even behind the TV. The ‘Voice” function recognizes spoken commands for changing channels, searching for a show, and more. High Clarity 4K HDR: Catvision Box supports 4K Ultra HD resolution with H.265 decoding technology. Enjoy a high quality viewing experience. BIS Certified Safety: Complies with Bureau of Indian Standards for electrical safety. Equipped with protection against overcurrent, short circuits, overcharging, over-discharging, and high voltage—ensuring safe and reliable performance. (BIS No-R-93035920)
